## Meeting Purpose

[Review eCat updates and resolve product display issues.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=112.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Product Search Broken:** Grouping variants under a parent code (e.g., `552-091-509-891`) breaks direct SKU search and scanning, as the individual SKUs are not indexed.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1148.0)
  - [**Solution Defined:** All individual variant SKUs will be imported as "hidden products." This enables direct search/scan while preserving the clean, grouped display.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
  - [**Data Feed Issues:** The API feed is missing active SKUs (e.g., `223-521-KW-S4`) and has incorrect field mappings (e.g., `catalog year`).](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1803.0)
  - [**Customer Data Process:** A new CSV import process is required to handle customer ship-to addresses, as the API lacks the necessary pricing code field.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1893.0)

## Topics

### Product Search & Variant Grouping

  - [**Problem:** Grouping product variants under a parent code breaks direct search and scanning for individual SKUs.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1148.0)
      - [**Example:** Searching for `552091` (Ashlyn Sofa) fails because it is hidden within a group identified by a parent code (`552-091-509-891`) that sales reps do not know.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1208.0)
  - [**Solution:** Import all individual variant SKUs as "hidden products."](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
      - [**Rationale:** This enables direct search/scan while preserving the clean, grouped display.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1570.0)
      - [**Display Name:** The "Show Hidden Products" toggle will be renamed to "Show All Variants" for clarity.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1620.0)
      - [**Scanning:** Scanning will find hidden products automatically, without the toggle.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1578.0)

### Data Feed & API Issues

  - [**Missing SKUs:** The API feed is missing active SKUs that are enabled in the backend.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=2144.0)
      - [**Example:** `223-521-KW-S4` (Antonella King set) is active but not in the feed.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=2144.0)
      - [**Finding:** `223-521-KW-S5` is correctly missing because it is marked "inactive" in the backend.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=2144.0)
  - [**Incorrect Field Mapping:** The `catalog year` field is pulling the wrong data.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1803.0)
      - [**Example:** `223-521-KW` shows `catalog year: 2021` in eCat but `2025` in the backend.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=339.0)

### Related Items & Collections

  - [**Related Items:** The API feed includes related items for some products (e.g., Leandro set).](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=758.0)
  - [**Collection Display:** The eCat will now display all products in a collection (e.g., dining table with all compatible chairs) to improve cross-selling.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1110.0)

### Customer Data Import

  - [**Requirement:** A new process is needed to import customer ship-to addresses.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1893.0)
  - [**Blocker:** The API lacks the `pricing code` field, which is essential for eCat functionality.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1988.0)
  - [**Solution:** Use a CSV file from Steven, transformed by Kyler's script to clean data (e.g., fix international addresses).](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=2029.0)

## Next Steps

  - [**Brent:**](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
      - [Implement "hidden products" solution for all variant SKUs.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
      - [Rename the "Show Hidden Products" toggle to "Show All Variants."](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1620.0)
      - [Send a Loom video demonstrating the scanning functionality.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1863.0)
      - [Get Kyler to share the customer data transformation script.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=2022.0)
  - [**Kevin:**](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1803.0)
      - [Correct the API field mapping for `catalog year`.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=1803.0)
      - [Investigate why active SKU `223-521-KW-S4` is missing from the API feed.](https://fathom.video/share/3QqRae7_bf41x-df2VbyT-r2FD36aUBq?tab=summary&timestamp=2144.0)

summary.markdown_formatted:
## Meeting Purpose

[Resolve critical data and UX issues blocking eCat adoption.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=136.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Variant Logic Fixed:** The `parent_code` API field is now live, enabling proper parent-child product grouping. This fixes a critical flaw where reps couldn't search child SKUs and the UI showed the wrong SKU for selected variants.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1703.0)
  - [**UI Clutter Reduced:** The `item_type: component` filter will be removed. This hides non-sellable parts (e.g., bed rails) that created a confusing "messy" UI, while preserving modular, sellable components (e.g., sectional pieces).](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1166.0)
  - [**Scanning UX Overhauled:** A new "scan group" UI will replace the current inefficient flow. Scanning any item from a set will now display all related pieces, allowing reps to build orders instantly.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1250.0)
  - [**Customer Data Sync:** The "off-by-one" address error will be fixed by a new customer file from Coaster. The team will also define a better customer filtering strategy (e.g., by `rep_code`) and explore automating address validation via the Google API.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1776.0)

## Topics

### Variant Product Grouping

  - [**Problem:** The current logic for grouping product variants (e.g., beds by size/color) is brittle and causes two critical issues:](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=408.0)
      - [**Search Failure:** Reps cannot find products by scanning or searching for a child SKU (e.g., a specific color/size variant).](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=421.0)
      - [**Misleading UI:** The UI shows the parent SKU (e.g., "Navy Q") even after a variant is selected, creating confusion.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=569.0)
  - [**Solution:** The API will now use the `parent_code` field to group variants.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=880.0)
      - [**API Fix:** Kevin confirmed the `parent_code` field was missing from the API response and has already fixed it.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1703.0)
      - [**eCat Implementation:** Brent will use `parent_code` to create a "virtual" parent product. Selecting a variant will dynamically swap in the correct child SKU for the order, fixing the UI discrepancy.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=614.0)

### Component Product Display

  - [**Problem:** The UI is cluttered with non-sellable "component" items (e.g., bed rails, headboards) that have no descriptions and create a poor user experience.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=160.0)
  - [**Solution:** Brent will filter out all items with `item_type: component`.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1166.0)
      - [**Rationale:** This cleans up the UI without losing functionality. Modular, sellable pieces (e.g., sectional arms) are classified differently and will remain visible for custom order building.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1166.0)

### Showroom Scanning Experience

  - [**Problem:** The current scanning workflow is inefficient. Scanning one item only adds it to the order after a *second* item is scanned, making it difficult to build multi-piece sets.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1503.0)
  - [**Solution:** Brent will implement a "scan group" UI.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1250.0)
      - [**Functionality:** Scanning any item from a set will display all related items (e.g., a sectional's armless chair, corner, etc.) on a single screen.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1250.0)
      - [**Benefit:** Reps can instantly select quantities for all pieces to build a complete order from one scan.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1250.0)
      - [**Data Source:** The `Group Number` field will be used to link related items. Kevin will also add a `related_group` field to the API to handle more complex relationships (e.g., one table paired with two different chair sets).](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1326.0)

### Customer Data & Sync

  - [**Problem:** The customer data file has an "off-by-one" error, causing incorrect ship-to addresses to display.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1776.0)
  - [**Solution:** Marlene will send a new, clean customer file to Brent to correct the error.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1934.0)
  - [**Future Automation:**](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1844.0)
      - [**Address Validation:** Morris will follow up on a project to use the Google API for automated address standardization, which would prevent future formatting errors.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1844.0)
      - [**Customer Filtering:** The team will define a better strategy for filtering customers sent to eCat, likely focusing on accounts with a `rep_code`.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=3000.0)
      - [**API Sync:** Product data will sync daily (up from weekly) to keep eCat current. A manual sync button will also be added for immediate updates.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2487.0)

### Admin & Future Topics

  - [**Product Fields:** Morris will prune unnecessary product fields (e.g., "max TV size") from the admin panel to simplify the UI.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2118.0)
  - [**Rep Assignments:** Brent will record a video tutorial for Marlene on how to configure rep groups by territory ("zoning").](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2056.0)
  - [**Email Deliverability:** Kevin confirmed SuperCat emails were blocked by Coaster's IT and has requested whitelisting to ensure delivery of password resets and error notifications.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2972.0)
  - [**Order History:** The next major project is integrating order history. Brent will provide documentation for Coaster to develop the necessary data file.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2873.0)

## Next Steps

  - [**Brent:**](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=3095.0)
      - [Implement `parent_code` logic to fix variant grouping.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1703.0)
      - [Remove `item_type: component` items from the product display.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1166.0)
      - [Develop the "scan group" UI for showroom scanning.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1250.0)
      - [Record and send the rep "zoning" tutorial video to Marlene.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2056.0)
      - [Send the API field mapping document to Morris.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2421.0)
  - [**Kevin:**](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2972.0)
      - [Add the `related_group` field to the API.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1403.0)
      - [Confirm SuperCat domain whitelisting with IT.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2972.0)
  - [**Marlene:**](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1934.0)
      - [Send the corrected customer data file to Brent.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1934.0)
  - [**Morris:**](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2118.0)
      - [Prune unnecessary product fields from the eCat admin panel.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=2118.0)
      - [Follow up on the Google API address validation project.](https://fathom.video/share/j21iPfWgLGsR1o3ayU31DBYQ8tEKyxCS?tab=summary&timestamp=1844.0)

summary.markdown_formatted:
## Meeting Purpose

[Resolve key product data issues blocking eCat adoption.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=157.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Variant Logic Fixed:** The API now exposes `parent_code` and `parent_flag`, enabling proper parent-child product grouping. This fixes a critical bug where reps couldn't search for child SKUs and the UI showed a misleading parent SKU.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=429.0)
  - [**Component Display Removed:** Products with `item_type: component` will be hidden from the catalog. This declutters the UI and resolves a pricing file conflict, unblocking the latest price update.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1193.0)
  - [**Scanning Experience Overhauled:** A new "Scan Group" UI will be implemented. Scanning a single item will now display all related products (e.g., sectional pieces), allowing reps to build complex orders instantly.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1271.0)
  - [**Customer Data & Sync:** A "ship to" address offset in the customer list will be fixed by resending a clean file. The product sync frequency will increase to daily, with a manual trigger button added for on-demand updates.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1672.0)

## Topics

### Product Data & UI Issues

  - [**Problem:** The current product data structure creates two critical issues:](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=429.0)
      - [**Cluttered UI:** The "Related" tab for products with `item_type: component` is messy and confusing.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=181.0)
      - [**Broken Variant Logic:** Reps cannot search for child SKUs (e.g., `KE` for a King bed) and the UI shows the parent SKU instead of the selected variant's SKU, creating a misleading order preview.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=429.0)
  - [**Solution:**](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1193.0)
      - [**Component Display:** Hide all products with `item_type: component` from the catalog.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1193.0)
          - [**Rationale:** These are not sellable items, and reps now have a separate system for ordering replacements.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=239.0)
          - [**Impact:** This unblocks the latest pricing file update.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1203.0)
      - [**Variant Logic:** Use the `parent_code` and `parent_flag` fields for proper grouping.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=901.0)
          - [**Fix:** Kevin Tang deployed a fix during the meeting to expose these fields in the API.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1725.0)
          - [**New Flow:** The UI will display a generic parent product; selecting options will dynamically update the SKU on the final order.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=635.0)

### Scanning & Order Building

  - [**Problem:** The current scanning workflow is inefficient, requiring reps to scan each item individually.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1524.0)
  - [**Solution:** Implement the "Scan Group" UI.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1271.0)
      - [**Function:** Scanning a single item (e.g., a sectional piece) will display all related products from its `group_number`, allowing reps to build a complete order from one scan.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1271.0)
      - [**Data Requirement:** The API needs a `related_group` field for items that belong to multiple groups (e.g., a dining table paired with two different chair sets). Kevin Tang will add this.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1424.0)

### Customer Data & Sync Process

  - [**Customer List Issue:** The customer list has a "ship to" address offset, showing incorrect addresses.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1955.0)
      - [**Cause:** Data validation errors from extra commas, international address formatting, and missing zip codes.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1816.0)
      - [**Resolution:** Kylor Johnson will share the list of \~60 specific errors. Marlene Vidal will then send a clean, updated customer file.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=1989.0)
  - [**API Sync Frequency:**](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=2521.0)
      - [**New Cadence:** Product sync will increase from weekly to daily to ensure new items are available faster.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=2570.0)
      - [**Control:** A manual sync button will be added to the admin panel for on-demand updates (e.g., after a main image is set).](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=2589.0)

### Admin & Future Topics

  - [**Admin Access:** Morris Yeh's password reset emails were blocked by a Coaster firewall. Kevin Tang will whitelist the SuperCat domain.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=2733.0)
  - [**Rep Group Zoning:** Brent Sanders will record a video tutorial for Marlene Vidal on how to create rep groups based on physical territories.](https://fathom.video/share/cryAy5uLtB3-xkcHWWphpsrfXTaNsLrz?tab=summary&timestamp=2077.0)

summary.markdown_formatted:
## Meeting Purpose

[Clarify product data structure and pricing for SuperCat onboarding.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=32.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Product Hierarchy:** Use 4 custom fields (`Collection Code`, `Category Code`, `Product Type`, `Subtype`) in the product file to map Magic Lite's unique product hierarchy, as SuperCat's standard fields are insufficient.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=217.0)
  - [**Pricing Model:** Map `List Price` to SuperCat's `Net Price` field and `DN Price` (Distributor Net) to a `Promotion Price` field. Reps can toggle which prices are visible to customers in the app.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=360.0)
  - [**Data Integrity:** Magic Lite will spot-check accessory images, as SuperCat's automated script incorrectly mapped parent product images to accessories.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=640.0)
  - [**API Integration:** Magic Lite has a budget and quote for a live GP API integration. Kylor will confirm the scope with Brent, as this was previously scoped out.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=891.0)

## Topics

### Product Data Structure

  - [**Problem:** Magic Lite's product hierarchy (`collections` vs. `product types`) is more complex than SuperCat's standard fields can support.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=48.0)
  - [**Solution:** Use 4 custom fields in the product file to map the hierarchy:](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=217.0)
      - [`Collection Code` (e.g., SL)](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=217.0)
      - [`Category Code` (e.g., Light)](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=217.0)
      - [`Product Type` (e.g., Linear, Application)](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=217.0)
      - [`Subtype`](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=217.0)
  - [**Accessories:** Manage as "related items" to parent products.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=257.0)
      - [**Functionality:** Accessories appear on a "Related Items" tab on the parent product's detail page.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=257.0)
      - [**Implementation:** Add a `Related Items` column to the product file, containing a comma-separated list of accessory SKUs.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=300.0)

### Pricing Model

  - [**Problem:** Determine how to structure Magic Lite's `List Price` and `DN Price` (Distributor Net) in SuperCat.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=360.0)
  - [**Solution:** Map prices to SuperCat's fields as follows:](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=365.0)
      - [`List Price` → `Net Price` field](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=365.0)
      - [`DN Price` → `Promotion Price` field](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=365.0)
  - [**Rep Visibility:** Reps can toggle which prices are visible to customers in the app (Net only, DN only, or both).](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=423.0)
  - [**Customer Visibility:** Pricing is login-protected by default. Magic Lite can decide if pricing is visible on the public-facing eCat online instance.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=526.0)

### Data Integrity & API

  - [**Accessory Images:**](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=640.0)
      - [**Problem:** SuperCat's automated script incorrectly mapped parent product images to accessories.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=640.0)
      - [**Action:** Jen's team will spot-check and correct all accessory images in the product file.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=640.0)
  - [**GP API Integration:**](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=891.0)
      - [**Context:** Magic Lite has a budget and quote from GP for a live API integration.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=967.0)
      - [**Action:** Kylor will confirm the scope with Brent, as this was previously scoped out.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=891.0)
      - [**Rationale:** An API is required to avoid manual updates for inventory and customer data.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=891.0)

## Next Steps

  - [**Kylor:**](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=769.0)
      - [Send updated product file with 4 custom hierarchy columns and a `Related Items` column.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=769.0)
      - [Confirm GP API integration scope with Brent.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=891.0)
  - [**Jen:**](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=769.0)
      - [Populate the updated product file with hierarchy data and related items.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=769.0)
      - [Have team spot-check and correct all accessory images.](https://fathom.video/share/883JzT2h_znmQ67G-VnnFLC3M5ZFzNoD?tab=summary&timestamp=640.0)
